summary: Iteration 9 testing complete: 10/10 backend tests PASS. Bug fix verified — Zoho project row now navigates in-app to /portal/project/:id (no longer emits projectsapi.zoho.eu link). New backend endpoints correctly require portal auth (GET /api/portal/projects/{id}, /api/portal/invoices/{id}, /api/portal/invoices/{id}/pdf all → 401 unauth). Regression clean: /api/health ok, /api/reviews approved-only, /api/stats/trust returns {reviews,avg,projects}, /api/admin/reviews/scan-invites → 401, /api/payments/invoice-checkout → 401. Email HTML contains Trustpilot + Facebook share buttons (Google URL blank → correctly omitted). Frontend: /portal anon shows portal-zoho-login + portal-register-form, /portal/project/341680000000084075 renders page-project-detail + project-back with graceful 401 error state and NO redirect to projectsapi.zoho.eu. Home page: trust-stats + 3 stat cards render, big grid featured-reviews removed, featured-reviews-compact hidden when 0 featured; after seeding a featured review it appears with review-card-compact-0 (verified end-to-end, then cleaned up). /admin/login regression: password form + admin-zoho-login both visible. No console/page errors.
action_items: No blocking issues — Zoho project link bug is fixed and new endpoints/UI polish are production-safe.
critical_code_review_comments: ProjectDetail.jsx correctly consumes /api/portal/projects/{id} via withCredentials and renders a graceful error card for 401 — no external Zoho URL exposed in DOM.

zoho_portal.py: project_detail endpoint delegates to _zoho_get which raises HTTPException on ≥400 — good, but consider adding same 'refresh once' semantics that exist on invoice PDF path (already handled inside _zoho_get via _refresh_and_retry, so this is fine).

Portal.jsx invoice row uses fmtAmount with Intl.NumberFormat('nl-NL', {currency}) fallback — safe against undefined values. openPdf/printPdf open in new tab; since PDF stream is behind session-cookie auth, printPdf's window.open + addEventListener('load') may not fire due to cross-tab restrictions but is acceptable degradation.
review_invites._share_buttons_html correctly omits platforms with blank env vars; test asserts Google absent and Trustpilot+Facebook present.
Old bug root cause was frontend rendering p.link.self.url — that code path is fully removed; the projects list now uses onClick to window.location.assign(`/portal/project/${p.id_string || p.id}`).
server.py still >800 lines — recommend extracting reviews CRUD next.

rca of the issue: Original bug: Portal.jsx projects list rendered <a href={p.link.self.url}> pointing at projectsapi.zoho.eu — a private Zoho REST endpoint requiring server-side OAuth headers, hence 'Site niet bereikbaar' when the browser followed the link. Fix (verified): (a) Portal.jsx projects list now uses onClick={() => window.location.assign(`/portal/project/${p.id_string || p.id}`)} — pure in-app navigation; (b) new page ProjectDetail.jsx fetches details via backend GET /api/portal/projects/{id} which correctly proxies with the user's Zoho token and requires portal session (401 without). No projectsapi.zoho.eu URL is emitted client-side anymore.
